sections.markdown:
## F — Structured research index and consolidated VERIFY list: alcohol, other drugs and driving
Knowledge facts: part C holds 43 fact blocks (sec12-F01 onward) from physical pages 93 to 98; part C2 holds 42 confusable and continuation blocks (sec12-R01 onward).
Exam authority: part A states the issuer, the July 1, 2022 content date, the multiple-choice format and its four roughly equal topic areas, the vision standard and the one-day retake wait from physical pages 3, 35 and 36; question count, passing score and time limit are unknown.
VERIFY list:
- TN-ALC-A-EXAM — question count, passing score and time limit not printed in the manual (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- TN-ALC-A-FRESH — content dated July 1, 2022; current edition and liveness unconfirmed (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- TN-ALC-D-SHARE — drugs and alcohol test share worded as at least, exactly and roughly one quarter (owner EvidenceLibrarian).
- TN-ALC-D-TABLE — DUI penalty and BAC tables rebuilt from separated text columns (owner EvidenceLibrarian).
- TN-ALC-D-INTERLOCK — ignition interlock offense durations printed as a broken sentence (owner EvidenceLibrarian).
- TN-ALC-D-SEIZURE — vehicle seizure: two convictions in five years versus any second conviction (owner HallucinationAuditor).
- TN-ALC-MARKET — market pack unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
- TN-ALC-TEARDOWN — competitive teardown unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
Dynamic facts: DUI penalties, the refusal suspension, the child endangerment add-ons, the under-twenty-one penalties, the dated fatality figures and the Redline number (for example sec12-F30, sec12-F34, sec12-F40, sec12-R23, sec12-R38, sec12-R41) can change and must be refreshed from official Tennessee sources.

corpus_stability.reason: The Tennessee Comprehensive Driver License Manual says its content is current as of July 1, 2022 and its back cover carries one March 2025 print authorization; nothing in the selected pages suggests more than one rewrite per year, but the content date is old, so freshness is held as debt rather than assumed.
